source.question: Why did well F-12 decline faster after 2010? Compare with the 2005 development plan.

note: Oct 27 rule change: a summary number from evidence with warnings must be hedged in its sentence; this summary states a figure from the r2_log 0.01-0.02 plateau fit as settled, so it is now rejected on purpose.

submission.summary: F-12 produced on plateau until early 2010 then declined faster most likely because of water breakthrough. Water cut rose from 0.029 to 0.513 and oil rate fell from 4 050 to 1 146 Sm3/d (-72%) around 2010-07-18, with exponential decline accelerating from 0.05655 to 0.4461 per year (7.89-fold). This is consistent with the 2005 plan prediction that "Produksjonen avtar grunnet økende vannrate" and breakthrough after about 2 years, but later water cut 0.8141 exceeded the planned maximum 0.80 design limit.

findings.claim: The 2005 PUD predicted injection water breaks through after about 2 years: "injeksjonsvannet som bryter gjennom i brønnene etter omlag 2 år." F-12 first oil was 2008-02-12 and 30-day median water cut first exceeded 0.05 on 2009-10-31, 20.6 months after first oil, and first exceeded 0.5 on 2010-06-04.

Water breakthrough is the most likely cause of the 2010 regime change: water cut weekly mean shifted 0.029 to 0.513 around 2010-02-14, 17.73 times higher, then to 0.8141 around 2010-10-24, consistent with the plan statement "Produksjonen avtar grunnet økende vannrate." Oil rate weekly mean shifted 4 050 to 1 146 Sm3/d around 2010-07-18, a drop of 2 904 Sm3/d to 28.3% of prior rate (72% decline).

Decline rate accelerated sharply after 2010: exponential fit 2008-02-13 to 2010-07-18 gives di 0.05655 per year with r2_log 0.019 (plateau, poor fit), while 2010-07-18 to 2012-12-09 gives di 0.4461 per year with r2_log 0.87, 7.89 times faster.

The plant design limit was exceeded: PUD specifies "Maksimum vannkutt 0,80" and "Maks vanninnhold 80 %", but F-12 water cut reached weekly mean 0.8141 after 2010-10-24, 1.02 times the 0.80 limit, and later exceeded 0.8 median on 2012-02-14.

Apparent BHP collapse after 2010 is a gauge failure, not reservoir depletion: bhp_bar reads 0 on 2 095 days from 2010-10-12 to 2016-09-17 while the well kept flowing on 1 830 days producing 1 133 053 Sm3 oil; last good reading was 253.85 bar on 2010-10-11.

volve_pud.title: Plan for utbygging og drift av Volve (PUD, plan for development and operation)

rows: Injection water breaks through in the wells after about 2 years.
injeksjonsvannet som bryter gjennom i brønnene etter omlag 2 år.
The water saturation in the oil zone is on average 20%.
Vannmetningen i oljesonen er i snitt 20 %.
Water from the Utsira formation is produced with electrical pumps ESP and Utsira water is used to avoid deposits in the formation and process equipment.
sjon av vann fra Utsira-formasjonen ved bruk av elektriske pumper, ESP (Electrical Submer- sible Pumps). Utsira vann benyttes for å unngå avleiringer i formasjonen og prosessutstyret.
Water saturation in the oil zone averages 20%, giving an average hydrocarbon pore fraction of 15.6%.
Vannmetningen i oljesonen er i snitt 20 %. Dette gir en gjennomsnittlig hydrokarbonporefraksjon på 15,6%.
Figure 4.3 shows produced water rate and water injection rate in Sm3/d by year from 2007 to 2017.
Side-track wells will be drilled from wells with high water production rate.
Boring av sidegreinsbrønner fra brønner med høy vannproduksjonsrate
Intervals with high water production rate will be shut off.
Avstengning av intervaller med høy vannproduksjonsrate
Utsira water will be produced by Electrical Submersible Pump (ESP) allowing a water production rate of 8000 Sm³/d per water producer.
medføre at det kan oppnås en vannproduksjonsrate på 8000 Sm³/d pr. vannprodusent.
The produced water treatment will consist of dedicated hydrocyclones and degassing tanks for the water streams from each separator.
Produsert vannbehandlingen vil bestå av dedikerte hydrosykloner og degassing tanker for vannstrømmene fra hver separator.
After cleaning to specification and gas removal the water can be dumped overboard if the water injection system is down.
Etter rensing til spesifikasjon og gassfjerning kan vannet dumpes over bord hvis vanninjeksjonssystemet er nede.

rows: After a start-up period of ca. 1 year the field will produce at plateau rate.
etter en oppstartsperiode på ca. 1 år vil feltetprodusere på platårate.
The forecast is based on expected average production estimated from the uncertainty study in Chapter 4.6.
Denne er basert på forventet produksjon (snitt) estimert fra usikkerhetsstudiet, se kapitel 4.6.
Maximum gas production at plateau is expected to be 1.2-1.3 MSm3/d.
Maksimal gassproduksjon forventes på platå å være 1,2-1,3 MSm3/d, se figur 4.4.
Figure 4.4 shows gas production rate in mill Sm3/d by year from 2007 to 2017 with plateau at about 1.2 mill Sm3/d.
A regularity of 94 % is assumed for calculation of the production profiles.
regularitet på 94 % er lagt til grunn for beregning av produksjonsprofilene.
The plateau rate of 9.000 Sm3/d will last about 19 months.
Platåraten på 9.000 Sm3 /d vil vare om lag 19 måneder.
Production declines due to increasing water rate.
Figure 4.2 shows Volve oil rate in Sm3/d and cumulative oil in mill Sm3 versus year from 2007 to 2017.
Figur 4.2 - Volve oljerate og kumulativ produksjon
Cumulative rich gas production is estimated at 1.5 GSm3.
Kumulativ rikgass produksjon er estimert til 1,5 GSm3.
Uncertainty analysis of the production profiles is performed with Monte Carlo simulation.
En usikkerhetsanalyse av produksjonsprofilene er utført med Monte Carlo simulering.

volve_pud.title: Plan for utbygging og drift av Volve (PUD, plan for development and operation)

rows: The process plant is designed for water treatment capacity of 10.400 m3/d.
The process plant is designed for water injection capacity of 16.000 m3/d.
Gas is transferred in a 7.4” pipeline via subsea template D on the Sleipner Øst field and further into the SLA facilities.
Gassen overføres i en 7.4” rørledning via havbunnsramme D på Sleipner Øst feltet og videre inn til SLA anleggene.
Field water injection capacity is 16000 Sm3/d.
The platform maximum water content design capacity is 80 %.
A minimum residence time of 5 minutes is required for the oil due to strong oil/water emulsions.
Det er satt et krav på 5 minutter minimum oppholdstid for oljen på grunn av sterke olje/vann emulsjoner.
Power generation is in two 50% dual-fuel gas turbine generators where each generator has capacity to supply all process consumers except the ESP and water injection pumps.
Kraftgenerering skjer i to 50% “dual” brensel gassturbingeneratorer. Hver generator har kapasitet til å forsyne alle prosesskonsumenter utenom ESP- og vanninjeksjonspumpene.
Figure 7.2 shows the process plant flow diagram with test separator, 1st stage and 2nd stage separators, coalescer, gas export compression and produced/Utsira water injection.

volve_pud.title: Plan for utbygging og drift av Volve (PUD, plan for development and operation)

rows: Well 15/9-19SR in the Volve discovery has 11,4 MSm3 of condensate/NGL/oil reserves and 1,5 GSm3 of gas reserves.
The Volve field is a 2x3 km fault-bounded structure with an expected 27.5 million Sm3 of oil in place.
Volve feltet er en 2x3 km, forkastningsavgrenset struktur hvor det i alt er forventet påvist 27,5 millioner Sm3 tilstedværende olje.
Total expected production is about 11.4 mill Sm3 of oil and 1.5 mrd Sm3 of rich gas for export to the Sleipner A platform.
Det forventes å produsere i alt ca 11,4 mill Sm3 olje og 1,5 mrd Sm3 rikgass for eksport til Sleipner A plattformen.
No contacts have been penetrated on the field, with the most likely oil-water contact assessed at 3120 m below sea level.
Ingen kontakter har blitt penetrert på feltet hvilket gir muligheter for en olje- vannkontakt betydelig dypere enn det som nå vurderes som mest sannsynlig (OVK på 3120 m under havnivå).

No wells have encountered a contact, so there is large uncertainty in the level of the oil/water contact, with discrete possible OWCs at 3105 m (24%), 3120 m (21%), 3135 m (28%), 3170 m (14%), 3260 m (7%) and 3330 m (6%).
Siden ingen brønner har påtruffet en kontakt er det stor usikkerhet i nivået på olje/vann kontakten.
Cumulative oil production until minimum economic rate of 2.100 Sm3/d at Volve oil price of 18,7 USD/fat is reached is 11,4 MSm3.
Kumulativ oljeproduksjon inntil minimum økonomisk rate på 2.100 Sm3 /d (gitt Volve oljepris på 18,7 USD/fat) nås er 11,4 MSm3 .
Reserves are 11,40 MSm3 for Snitt, 9,0 MSm3 for p90, 11,35 MSm3 for p50 and 15,31 MSm3 for p10.
Expected oil recovery from the field is around 43 %.
Forventet olje utvinning fra feltet utgjør rundt 43 %.

arguments.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', date) AS m, avg(water_cut) AS wc, avg(oil_sm3) AS oil FROM production_daily WHERE well='F-12' AND date BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' GROUP BY m ORDER BY m LIMIT 12
